usageMeasurementConsent: Allow Google Firebase Analytics to measure app activity, returning visits, successful account creation and newly saved warranties? Advertising storage and ad personalization stay disabled for this measurement. This is separate from Meta and ad choices. Optional: decline or turn it off in Settings at any time. No past activity is replayed.
